name: HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Pioneer (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core)
description: The HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Pioneer is a fully tunable magnetic speed cube built around a spherical ball-core with 20 core magnets and 6 magnetic rings, adding up to 82 magnets across the puzzle. The Pioneer trim leans into acceleration — the extra ring magnets converge force at the core edges and disperse it at the corners, so every turn gets a noticeable magnetic push.
features: Quiet enough for anywhere: Full lubrication and high-precision processing keep noise down, whether you're practicing at your desk or on the couch.
Numerical micro-setting: Compression and tension are both set on numbered dials, so replicating a top cuber's feel is as simple as matching the numbers.
26-point core positioning: Up to 26 magnets in the core work with the 20 corner-foot magnets to produce diverse positioning effects across the whole cube.
Auto-assisted homing: Magnetic repulsion combined with inertia adds acceleration and helps the cube settle into place, keeping operation smooth and stable.
Spherical ball-core: An integrated maglev core drives auto-alignment and adds stability, so layers snap true and stay planted.
Great corner-cutting: Rounded gradient curves, structural optimization, and anti-corner-twist geometry cut down on lock-ups.
